messages:
maya-billing: Heads-up: Helios Care (acct: HC-2045) had ACH onboarding fail with `account_type_mismatch` on microdeposits. Invoice 53210 ($2,150) is scheduled for tomorrow morning and the customer asked if we can accept a one-time same-day wire to prevent service suspension.
dave-payments: Paste the gateway/bank webhook? Could be corporate vs personal checking or bank flagging microdeposits as unsupported.
maya-billing: Webhook raw: `status: failed`, `decline_code: account_type_mismatch`, `bank_message: Microdeposit verification not supported for account type - commercial`. Customer note: "treasury used corporate checking through our payroll bank".
ops-oncall: Please pause autopay retries for HC-2045 to avoid duplicate capture. Also add note to ticket that support should not retry until wire clears.
billing-bot: Payment attempt 2027-03-02 11:09 UTC (txn id: pay_q7p4) failed; next retry scheduled per policy. Flag created: FLAG-MANUAL-2201.
nora-finance: Quick checklist: (1) Is autopay enabled? (2) Any prior disputes or account holds? If no disputes, we can accept wire for <$50k with VP sign-off and a one-off addendum for audit.
maya-billing: Autopay is enabled and failing. No disputes. Customer treasury says they can wire today but need the exact wiring info and a short pro-forma.
dave-payments: I'm fine approving a manual wire for <$50k. @cecilia-vpfinance can you confirm? Also request the customer sign a one-time billing addendum and confirm they'll cover outbound/intermediary bank fees.
cecilia-vpfinance: Approve manual wire acceptance for invoice 53210 ($2,150). Conditions: (A) Customer must email remittance to billing@redwood.ai with bank trace/reference; (B) Signed addendum uploaded to billing folder; (C) Customer covers any intermediary/outgoing fees unless exception is approved in writing. Proceed with wiring instructions.
maya-billing: Sending wiring details + pro-forma to the customer and cc'ing support + finance. Pausing autopay retries now.
maya-billing: Wire instructions (sent):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Concordia Bank (US clearing)
Routing (ABA): 091000022
Account: 7766554433
SWIFT: CDBKUS33
Reference: Invoice 53210 - HC-2045
Remittance email: billing@redwood.ai
Note: Please include full invoice amount and attach bank trace/confirmation in your remittance email.
```
Customer reply: "Treasury will initiate same-day wire and send trace once posted."
ops-oncall: Confirmed: support paused retries and added ticket note to avoid double-billing.
dave-payments: After funds post we'll mark invoice paid and cancel any scheduled retries. Maya, please upload the signed addendum and remittance email to the audit folder once received.
maya-billing: Will upload docs when I have them. Checklist: signed addendum (pending), remittance trace (pending), ledger reconcile after post.
billing-bot: Reminder set: reconcile after bank posting; audit flag: MANUAL-2201.
nora-finance: Thanks team — once the wire posts I'll reconcile and close the invoice. Appreciate the quick turnaround :white_check_mark:
